t: You're at the memorial to Brian Haw on Lambeth Road. Haw was a British peace campaigner who lived for almost ten years, from 2001, in a peace camp in Parliament Square, protesting against UK and US foreign policy. His campaign began before the September 11 attacks, and he became a symbol of the anti-war movement over Afghanistan and later Iraq. In 2007 he was voted Most Inspiring Political Figure at the Channel 4 Political Awards. He died of cancer in Berlin.
